title: One-Punch Man Season 3 Anime's 2nd Part Reveals January 2027 Debut in Video
content:
Bandai Namco Filmworks revealed in a new trailer on Sunday that the second cours (quarter of a year) of the third anime season based on ONE and Yūsuke Murata 's One Punch Man manga will debut in January 2027.

Viz Media is streaming an English-subtitled version of the trailer.

Both videos reveal that JAM Project is returning to perform the opening theme song titled "Never Done - SUPREME POWER VS ULTIMATE FEAR -."

The anime's website also revealed a new key visual.

The third season premiered with a recap on October 5, 2025. The overall 25th episode of the anime, the first episode in the third season, aired a week later. The anime is streaming on Hulu in the U.S., Disney+ in Canada, and Netflix in Latin America, Australia, and New Zealand. In Latin America and Oceania, Crunchyroll is also streaming the anime.

J.C. Staff is returning from the second season to animate the series. Madhouse animated the first season.

Shinpei Nagai ( Inugami-san to Nekoyama-san , DOGEZA: I Tried Asking While Kowtowing. ) is directing the anime at J.C. Staff . Tomohiro Suzuki returns from previous seasons to oversee the series scripts. Chikashi Kubota also returns from previous seasons as character designer, but this time alongside Shinjiro Kuroda and Ryōsuke Shirakawa . Sakura Murakami is now the art director (Murakami previously worked on background art for the second season, with Shigemi Ikeda and Yukiko Maruyama previously credited as art directors for the second season). Mayumi Tanahashi returns as color designer from the second season. Yuki Hirose is now the director of photography (replacing Yoshio Ōkouchi from the previous season). Masahiro Gotō , Yoshikazu Iwanami , and Makoto Miyazaki all return from the second season as editor, sound director, and music composer, respectively.

JAM Project with metal group BABYMETAL performed the opening theme song "Get No Satisfied!," and Makoto Furukawa performed the ending theme song "Soko ni Aru Akari" ("The Light, That's There") for the first cours .

The first anime season aired in Japan from October to December 2015.

The second season began with a television special in April 2019, then the first episode premiered one week later.

title: Fall 2026 Has Two Anime That Turn Solo Leveling’s Power Fantasy Into Comedy
content:
It is already the second week of Fall 2026, and yet the season is still blooming, with many new anime yet to be released, proving that there is still plenty to look forward to. The Fall season is indeed a fruitful one for anime, featuring a variety of series, including returning anime with new seasons and several newcomers making their debut. However, ever since Solo Leveling debuted in 2024, bringing a power system rooted in a Korean webtoon to the forefront, there has been at least one new anime that draws comparisons to its narrative pattern, and 2026 has been particularly keen on featuring such series.

It started with Tomb Raider King in the Summer season earlier this year, and now the Fall season has Overgeared , another anime being compared to Solo Leveling for similar reasons: its depiction of a self-leveling journey based on a Korean webtoon, or manhwa. However, Overgeared brings its own nuance to the formula, offering an amusing take on the Solo Leveling trope that blends naturally with the series. Now, earlier this week, on October 6, The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life debuted, taking the power system trope seen in anime such as Solo Leveling even further.

Two Fall 2026 Anime Put a Hilarious Twist on Solo Leveling ’s Main Trope

Anime such as Solo Leveling , which follow a protagonist’s journey of leveling up and gaining unparalleled power, tend to take a more serious approach. Sung Jinwoo’s journey has maintained a serious tone from the start as he goes from zero to hero, never showing an ounce of unseriousness along the way. As he reaches a level where he is stronger than everyone else, the story eventually becomes about aura farming, with him dominating almost every scene he enters. This is precisely why the two currently airing anime stand out as hilarious alternatives, taking an amusing turn on the familiar trope.

Overgeared , with its protagonist , showcases someone desperate to succeed in life and willing to do anything to achieve it. Grid frequently finds himself begging for his life, much like a hilarious side character in any power-leveling series. Across its two episodes, Grid begins his leveling-up adventure, only to lose some of his levels and even reach a negative level. However, his desperation for success becomes a source of comedy as he continues to work hard and demonstrate determination, all while never hiding his weak, vulnerable side or being afraid to ask for help, making him feel more relatable. Meanwhile, The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life takes a more direct parody approach to the power system trope.

It features Rein, an enchanter who strengthens his guildmates’ equipment but gets kicked out after they realize their weapons cannot be upgraded any further because they have reached their maximum potential. After being expelled, Rein takes the mana from all the other equipment and hilariously transfers it into a copper sword, turning it into a cheat weapon capable of destroying anything in its path. However, instead of embarking on a revenge journey and taking himself too seriously, Rein begins a carefree, laid-back adventure. It is a hilarious take on the power system that few would expect from an overpowered protagonist, making the anime feel refreshing among the many series compared to Solo Leveling every season.

With two Fall anime taking a different approach instead of simply depicting Solo Leveling ‘s power fantasy, fans can enjoy the familiar appeal of watching an overpowered protagonist while getting a refreshing and amusing experience that feels entirely new.

title: Naruto Mobile Game to Get Worldwide Release; Naruto Card Game Reveals Demo, Release Dates
content:
The "NARUTO: What's Next?" panel at New York Comic Con announced on Saturday that the Naruto Mobile game, currently only available in Mainland China, will get a worldwide release. More details will be revealed at the Jump Festa '27 event, which will take place on December 19-20.

The original game launched in Mainland China in 2016.

Additionally, the event revealed more details about Naruto Card Game , a new trading card game in the franchise.

Studio Pierrot produced a trailer for the upcoming trading card game, which was played during the panel.

Select trading card game stores will host demos for the game from February 5-19 and February 19 through March 5, before a wider demo event at more stores on March 5-31.

The game will officially launch in June 2027. The game will have three starter decks centered around Naruto, Sasuke, and Gaara.

Bandai previously released the Naruto Collectible Card Game in 2006 until 2013.

Both projects are part of an overall " Project Rasengan " announced at the panel. "Project Rasengan" is a project that will "chart the future of Naruto and Boruto as it expands long term" through anime, manga, games and other media.

title: Naruto to Officially Return With Brand-New Manga From Original Creator – Watch First Look Trailer
content:
Naruto ‘s creator is officially returning to the series with a brand new manga, and the first look has been revealed at what to expect. Naruto has kicked off a new wave of projects that are being lined up for the next three years at least. Taking the stage during the New York Comic Con 2026 weekend , the franchise detailed a lot of the new projects now in the works during a special panel. But there’s one big surprise that fans certainly never expected to see happen. Kishimoto’s going back to the story for more.

It has been officially announced that Masashi Kishimoto is now working on a brand new Naruto manga series. Dubbed “Shadow Rising,” this new Naruto series teases that it will explore a piece of the canon that had only been hinted at before. Because while Boruto: Naruto Next Generations is an official sequel set even further in the timeline , this new series teases what happens before Naruto is officially crowned as the Seventh Hokage. Check out the first look teaser trailer below.

New Naruto Shadow Rising Manga Announced

Naruto Shadow Rising (which has yet to be confirmed as the official name of the series) revealed its first look teaser trailer at the very end of the New York Comic Con 2026 panel, and it was there that it was confirmed that fans will be getting much more infromation about the new series during Jump Festa 2027 later this December . But while very little concrete information has been revealed about the series thus far, it’s plenty exciting already as Kishimoto is making a proper return to the franchise. Especially since he’s been around it for so long.

Kishimoto returned to Naruto for a special one-shot story for Minato Namikaze as part of the franchise’s 20th anniversary some time ago, and has been helping out with the story for the Boruto: Naruto Next Generations sequel series. But with this interquel, the creator is going back in full to the franchise. It does raise a lot of questions about whether or not it will overshadow the ongoing sequel manga series ( which is now celebrating its own 10th anniversary ), but there are still many questions such as how long this new series will ultimately run for.

Naruto Confirms Return With New Shonen Jump Anime Crossover

This isn’t all that is in the works for the Naruto franchise, however, as there’s a new revival anime now in production. First revealed to be in the works back in 2023 before its indefinite delay, it was confirmed during the New York Comic Con 2026 panel that this revival is actually going to be a crossover with a surprise Shonen Jump classic franchise, Koji Kiriyama’s Ninku . A series that hasn’t had an anime in 30 years, and is making a proper return with this new four episode special crossover.

A release date or window has yet to be announced for Naruto x Ninku as of the time of this announcement, but the trailer above teases the classic Team 7 line up ending up in a whole new universe. Naruto has planned out new projects through to at least 2029 ( including a new live-action movie now in the works ), so we’ll see much more of it all soon enough. What are you hoping to see in Naruto ‘s official manga return? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Masashi Kishimoto to Launch New Naruto Manga
content:
The "NARUTO: What's Next?" panel at New York Comic Con announced on Saturday that Masashi Kishimoto will launch a new manga in his Naruto franchise. The below video teases a possible title: Shadow Rising Naruto (or Naruto Shadow Rising ). More details will be revealed at the Jump Festa '27 event, which will take place on December 19-20.

Kishimoto launched the Naruto ninja manga in Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in 1999, and ended the series in November 2014. The manga has spawned the Naruto and Naruto Shippūden television anime series, original video anime ( OVA ) projects, several anime films, spinoff manga, the Boruto sequel manga and anime series, a series of novels, stage plays, and video games.

Manga storywriter Ukyō Kodachi and Mikio Ikemoto launched the Boruto sequel manga in Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in May 2016, and the manga ran monthly in the magazine. The manga transferred to V Jump in July 2019. Kishimoto replaced Kodachi as the manga's storywriter in November 2020, starting with the manga's 52nd chapter.

The manga went on hiatus in April 2023 and returned with the title Boruto: Two Blue Vortex in August 2023. The series is ongoing.

title: Dr. Stone TV Anime Gets Terraforming Sequel
content:
The "Stone Fes. 2026" event announced on Saturday that production has been green-lit on Dr. Stone Terraforming , a sequel to the television anime of Riichirou Inagaki and Boichi 's Dr. Stone manga . The new anime will adapt the "Terraforming" sequel story, set after the main story, from the 27th manga volume.

The first television anime premiered in July 2019. Crunchyroll streamed the first season as it aired, and Funimation streamed a dub of the season. The anime premiered on Toonami in August 2019.

Dr. Stone: Stone Wars , the anime's second season, premiered in January 2021. Crunchyroll streamed the series worldwide except in Asia, and Funimation streamed an English dub . The anime debuted on Toonami in May 2021.

The one-hour Dr. Stone: Ryusui anime special aired in July 2022.

The first cours (quarter of the year) of Dr. Stone: New World , the third Dr. Stone anime season, premiered in Japan in April 2023, and ended with its 11th episode. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan, and also streamed an English dub . The anime began running on Toonami in June 2023. The anime's second cours premiered in Japan in October 2023. The 22nd and final episode of Dr. Stone: New World aired in December 2023.

The first cours of Dr. Stone: Science Future , the fourth and final season of the original Dr. Stone anime series, debuted in January 2025. The season's second cours premiered on July 10, 2025 and ended on September 25, 2025. The Dr. Stone: Science Future season ended after its third part on June 25.

Boichi ( Sun-Ken Rock ) and Riichirou Inagaki (author of Eyeshield 21 ) launched the manga in Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in March 2017, and ended the series in March 2022. Viz Media published the manga digitally and in print. MANGA Plus also published the manga digitally in English.

title: Naruto Gets Crossover Anime With Ninku Franchise
content:
The "NA RUTO: What's Next?" panel at New York Comic Con announced on Saturday more information about the new television anime "limited" series teased last month. The new anime is a crossover anime with Koji Kiriyama 's Ninku ninja manga titled NARUTO ×NINKŪ.

The panel explained that Ninku inspired Masashi Kishimoto to create Naruto , and as the below teaser video quotes from Kishimoto, "Without Ninku , there would be no Naruto . I wanted to read more of Ninku , so I started drawing Naruto ."

Kishimoto and Kiriyama are both supervising the completely original story of the anime. In the story, Naruto is serving as acting captain of Team 7 as Kakashi cannot go with them. Then Naruto, Sasuke, and Sakura accidentally wander into the world of Ninku .

Boruto: Naruto Next Generations chief director and Ninku anime director Noriyuki Abe is directing the crossover anime. Tetsuya Nishio , who worked on both the Naruto and Ninku anime, is the character designer and chief animation director.

The event also revealed collaboration key visual, as well as celebration illustrations from both manga creators.

Junko Takeuchi and Noriaki Sugiyama , the voice actors of Na ruto and Sasuke in the anime, appeared at the panel, along with Pierrot Films executive producer Yoshihiro Tominaga .

Kiriyama's Ninku manga ran in Weekly Shonen Jump from 1993 to 1995 and had nine compiled volumes. The manga inspired a television anime by Studio Pierrot in 1995-1996 that ran for 55 episodes. The Ninku Knife no Bohyō film debuted in 1994, and the separate Ninku the Movie opened in 1995. The Ninku Second Stage: Eto Nin-Hen sequel manga launched in Shueisha 's Ultra Jump magazine in 2005, and ended in 2011. The manga has 12 volumes.

Before the new crossover anime airs, Studio Pierrot will stream the first five episodes of Ninku for free on its YouTube channel.

The Naruto anime had announced four "brand-new" episodes in 2023 to commemorate the anime's 20th anniversary, with a plan for those episodes to air weekly starting in September 2023. However, a week prior to their planned debut, the episodes were delayed to improve their quality. There has been no new news about those four episodes since August 2023, and it is currently unclear if this newly announced crossover anime is related to that delayed project.

Kishimoto launched the Naruto ninja manga in Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in 1999, and ended the series in November 2014. The manga has spawned the Naruto and Naruto Shippūden television anime series, original video anime ( OVA ) projects, several anime films, spinoff manga, the Boruto sequel manga and anime series, a series of novels, stage plays, and video games.

Lionsgate is producing a Hollywood live-action film adaptation of the manga. The official website for the Naruto franchise announced on July 10 that the live-action film project had begun a global casting search for the main characters Naruto , Sasuke, and Sakura, with casting for other characters to come at a later date. Charles Melton (Riverdale, Beef ) is "in final negotiations " to play the mentoring ninja Kakashi Hatake in the film. Destin Daniel Cretton ( Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings, Spider-Man: Brand New Day ) is directing the film, and is also producing the film through his company Hisako alongside Jeyun Munford . Arad Productions ' Avi Arad , Ari Arad , and Emmy Yu as well as Jeremy Latcham are listed as producers.

Charles Melton (Riverdale, Beef ) is "in final negotiations " to play the mentoring ninja Kakashi Hatake in the film. Destin Daniel Cretton ( Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings, Spider-Man: Brand New Day ) is directing the film, and is also producing the film through his company Hisako alongside Jeyun Munford . Arad Productions ' Avi Arad , Ari Arad , and Emmy Yu as well as Jeremy Latcham are listed as producers.

title: Naruto to Return With New Shonen Jump Crossover Anime No Fan Could’ve Seen Coming
content:
It’s official, Naruto is now on the works for a return from the classic anime franchise but it’s with a crossover that no fan could have ever seen coming. Naruto fans have been eagerly waiting for the franchise to make its proper return as following the 20th anniversary of the Masashi Kishimoto’s franchise, it was first confirmed that Naruto was in the works on a new anime revival. This has finally been revealed as part of the New York Comic Con 2026 weekend , but it’s a series that no fans could have guessed.

Shueisha had officially revealed that Naruto would be showcasing the first look at Naruto’ s brand new anime return during the New York Comic Con 2026 weekend , and it turns out to be a new crossover with a major Shonen Jump classic series, Koji Kiriyama’s Ninku. The two ninja hits are crossing over in a brand new story in a collaboration between both Masashi Kishimoto and Koji Kiriyama, and the first look at this crossover has been revealed with a new trailer. You can check it out below.

New Naruto x Ninku Shonen Jump Anime Crossover Announced

Directed by Noriyuki Abe with chief animation and character designs provided by Tetusuya Nishio, these two staffers not only worked together on the classic Ninku anime series from the 1990s but also have experience with Boruto: Naruto Next Generations and the Naruto anime franchise releases. Both Naruto creator Masashi Kishimoto and Ninku creator Koji Kiriyama have worked together to help create the original story for the new Shonen Jump crossover. As Kishimoto stated with a special message during the panel, Ninku was a great inspiration to his work on Naruto .

Naruto x Ninku will be a special anime that taps into the full nostalgia of both projects. Not only is Ninku going to get a proper facelift in order to better fit into the modern era, but Naruto ‘s original incarnation of Team 7 will be front and center (though it was revealed during the panel that Kakashi won’t make the jump to this other universe) with this crossover as well. This includes the younger versions of Naruto, Sakura and Sasuke and this seems to be the full incarnation of the revival anime special that had been announced back in 2023 before being hit with an indefinite delay.

What Is Ninku Anyway?

Koji Kiryama’s Ninku first made its debut in the pages of Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in 1993, and ran for two years before returning for an official sequel sometime after. This then led to a successful TV anime series outing with 55 episodes, and a few feature film outings to boot. The series introduced fans to a wild looking new boy named Fusuke who comes from the titular Ninku school that mixes ninjutsu and kung fu. But this is going to be the first new anime release for the franchise in 30 years.

This was the four episode revival series that Naruto had previously revealed to be in the works, but clearly has taken on a shape that no anime fan could have ever seen coming. It’s a dream project for Kishimoto as he’s revealed that Ninku was a big inspiration for his own work, but fans of the franchise might not feel the same way after waiting for so long to see more of what they hoped would be a more proper return from Naruto.

How do you feel about this first look at the Naruto and Ninku crossover? Is it the kind of anime return you had been hoping for? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Kolkata Anime India Convention to Take Place on February 27-28
content:
The convention will host its first-ever Hyderabad event on November 14-15 at The Address Convention Centre, Narsingi.

Naruto director Hayato Date ( Naruto Shippūden , Flame of Recca ) attended the Mumbai 2026 event as a guest. Voice actor Akari Yura ( The Beginning After The End , Catch Me at the Ballpark! ) performed as a musical act at the convention's concert, and Luna Goami ( Sparks of Tomorrow ) and Mofmofmo performed at the concert. ASCA ( Sword Art Online: Alicization , Edens Zero ) also performed at the event. Producer Ryōta Hasegawa ( Dr. Stone , Sakamoto Days ) attended the event as a guest. The event hosted meet and greets for all four musical artists as well as with Ryōta Hasegawa . Kadokawa participated in a "fireside chat" in the event's Animation & More Summit, as did ' Sony YAY!'

Anime India hosted voice actor Kazuhiko Inoue ( Naruto , Parasyte -the maxim- , 2025 Ranma ½ ) as a guest at its event in Delhi. Delhi Anime India took place at Yashobhoomi Convention Centre on June 6 and June 7. YURiKA ( Little Witch Academia , Miss Kuroitsu From the Monster Development Department ) performed at the event as well.

Anime India hosted its Kolkata event at Biswa Bangla Mela Prangan on February 14 and February 15. The event featured a panel and a workshop by director Susumu Mitsunaka ( Haikyu!! director, Weathering With You key animator).

Anime India's previous Mumbai event took place in 2025 from August 22 through August 24 at NESCO BEC in Mumbai. Director Tetsuro Araki attended the event as the "flagship guest." Voice actor Tsunko ( D4DJ First Mix , D4DJ All Mix ), president of Avex Pictures ' Hideo Katsumata , and DJ Tōko Nakamura also attended the event as guests. Hikari Dobashi attended the event as an exhibitor representing TV Tokyo .

title: Crunchyroll Acquires Indian Rights to The Apothecary Diaries Anime Film
content:
The company has acquired the North American and worldwide rights (excluding Asia but including India) for the film.

The film will open in theaters in Japan on December 11 and will feature a brand-new story by the original novel series' author Hyuganatsu . Mariya Ise joins the cast as Mu Qing (English romanization not confirmed).

The story follows Maomao and Jinshi as they travel to the hometown of a concubine who died five years ago in the imperial harem, to return her remains to her homeland. There, they encounter pirates, hidden treasures, the secret of the Empress' remains, and a mysterious boy who holds the key to the story.

The third television anime season premiered on October 2 at 11:00 p.m. (10:00 a.m. EDT) in the "Friday Anime Night" programming block on NTV and 29 affiliated channels for its first cours (quarter of a year), and its second cours will premiere in April 2027. Crunchyroll is streaming the season in India.

The anime's first season premiered in October 2023 with the first three episodes, and aired for two cours (quarters of a year). Crunchyroll streamed the anime in India as it aired in Japan and also streamed an English dub . The Tamil and Telugu dubs for the season streamed in July 2024. Netflix added the anime in April 2025.

The second anime season premiered in January 2025 on Nippon TV 's FRIDAY ANIME NIGHT programming block, and aired for two consecutive cours . Crunchyroll streamed the season in India as it aired in Japan and also streamed an English dub .

J-Novel Club publishes the novel series digitally, and it describes the story:

In the East is a land ruled by an emperor, whose consorts and serving women live in a sprawling complex known as the hougong, the rear palace. Maomao, an unassuming girl raised in an unassuming town by her apothecary father, never imagined the rear palace would have anything to do with her—until she was kidnapped and sold into service there. Though she looks ordinary, Maomao has a quick wit, a sharp mind, and an extensive knowledge of medicine. That's her secret, until she encounters a resident of the palace at least as perceptive as she is: the head eunuch, Jinshi. He sees through Maomao's façade and makes her a lady-in-waiting to none other than the Emperor's favorite consort... so she can taste the lady's food for poison!

Hyuganatsu began serializing the story on the "Shōsetsuka ni Narō" (Let's Become Novelists) website in October 2011. Shufunotomo began publishing the novels in print volume with illustrations by Shino in August 2014. Nekokurage launched an ongoing manga adaptation in Square Enix 's Monthly Big Gangan magazine in May 2017. Square Enix Manga & Books is releasing the manga adaptation in English. The company is also publishing the novels in print.
